title: TronLink MCP tool contracts — static snapshot
description: Full tool definitions (name, description, inputSchema) captured from the published npm MCP servers via the MCP tools/list endpoint. Tool annotations would be captured too, but the current servers publish none. The running server's tools/list remains the source of truth; this file is a stamped snapshot for one-fetch consumption.

tools.name: tl_accessibility_snapshot
tools.description: Get trimmed accessibility tree with deterministic refs (e1, e2, ...) for element targeting.

tools.name: tl_chain_create_multisig_tx
tools.description: Create an unsigned multisig TRX transfer transaction with a specific permission ID.

permission_id.description: Permission ID to use (default: 2 = first active permission)

tools.name: tl_chain_get_account
tools.description: Query TRON account: TRX balance, bandwidth, energy, permissions, activation status.

address.description: TRON address to query (default: configured wallet)

tools.name: tl_chain_get_address
tools.description: Get the TRON address derived from the configured private key (base58 + hex).

tools.name: tl_chain_get_history
tools.description: Query transaction history for an address with pagination.

tools.name: tl_chain_get_staking
tools.description: Query TRX staking info: frozen amounts for bandwidth/energy, votes, pending unfreezing, withdrawable amounts.

address.description: TRON address to query staking info (default: configured wallet)

tools.name: tl_chain_get_tokens
tools.description: Query TRC10 and TRC20 token balances for an address.

address.description: TRON address to query tokens for (default: configured wallet)

tools.name: tl_chain_get_tx
tools.description: Get transaction details by transaction ID (hash).

tools.name: tl_chain_resource
tools.description: Delegate, undelegate, or query resource delegations (bandwidth/energy).

amount_trx.description: Amount of TRX resource to delegate/undelegate

lock.description: Lock delegation (cannot be undelegated during lock period)

tools.name: tl_chain_send
tools.description: Send TRX, TRC10 or TRC20 tokens to an address. Signs and broadcasts the transaction.

amount.description: Amount to send (e.g. "1.5" for TRX, or token amount string)

tools.name: tl_chain_setup_multisig
tools.description: Configure multisig permissions on the account (accountPermissionUpdate, costs 100 TRX).

threshold.description: Required signature weight threshold for active permission

tools.name: tl_chain_sign_multisig_tx
tools.description: Sign a multisig transaction with the owner or co-signer key. Accumulates signatures.

transaction.description: Unsigned or partially signed transaction object (from chain_create_multisig_tx)

use_cosigner.description: Sign with co-signer key instead of owner key (default: false)

tools.name: tl_chain_stake
tools.description: Freeze or unfreeze TRX for bandwidth or energy (Stake 2.0).

tools.name: tl_chain_swap
tools.description: Estimate or execute a token swap via SunSwap V2 router.

action.description: Swap action: estimate (quote only) or execute (sign & broadcast)

from_token.description: Source token address or "TRX" for native TRX

to_token.description: Target token address or "TRX" for native TRX

tools.name: tl_chain_swap_v3
tools.description: Estimate or execute a token swap via SunSwap V3 (concentrated liquidity). Pre-checks balance before execution. Supports fee tier selection.

action.description: Swap action: estimate (quote only) or execute (sign & broadcast)

from_token.description: Source token address or "TRX" for native TRX

to_token.description: Target token address or "TRX" for native TRX

sqrt_price_limit.description: Price limit for partial fills (optional, advanced)

tools.name: tl_cleanup
tools.description: Safely close browser and all services (chain, fixtures, mock server).

force.description: Force cleanup even if session appears inactive

tools.name: tl_click
tools.description: Click an element by a11yRef (e.g. "e5"), testId, or CSS selector.

force.description: Force click even if element is obscured

tools.name: tl_clipboard
tools.description: Read or write the browser clipboard (useful for copying addresses, mnemonics).

text.description: Text to write (required for write operation)

tools.name: tl_close_tab
tools.description: Close a browser tab by role or URL pattern.

role.description: Role of the tab to close

tools.name: tl_describe_screen
tools.description: Comprehensive screen description: wallet state + testIds + accessibility tree + optional screenshot.

tools.name: tl_evaluate
tools.description: Execute JavaScript in the browser page context. Useful for DOM manipulation, scrolling, reading state, or any operation not covered by other tools. Returns the serialized result.

script.description: JavaScript expression to evaluate in page context. Return value will be serialized.

tools.name: tl_gasfree_get_account
tools.description: Query GasFree account eligibility, supported tokens, and remaining daily quota for gas-free TRC20 transfers.

address.description: TRON address to query GasFree eligibility (default: configured wallet)

tools.name: tl_gasfree_get_transactions
tools.description: Query GasFree transaction history: pending, completed, or failed gas-free transfers.

tools.name: tl_gasfree_send
tools.description: Send a GasFree TRC20 transfer (no gas fee). Pre-checks: account eligibility, token support, daily quota, and token balance.

amount.description: Token amount to send (in token units, e.g. "10.5")

tools.name: tl_get_context
tools.description: Get current context, capabilities, and session info.

tools.name: tl_get_contract_address
tools.description: Get the address of a previously deployed contract by name.

tools.name: tl_get_state
tools.description: Get TronLink wallet state: current screen, account, network, TRX balance, energy, bandwidth.

tools.name: tl_keyboard
tools.description: Send keyboard events. Press keys (e.g. "Enter", "PageDown", "End", "Control+A") or type text character by character (fires real key events, unlike tl_type which uses fill).

key.description: Key or key combination to press (e.g. "Enter", "Control+A", "PageDown", "End")

text.description: Text to type via keyboard events (character by character, fires key events unlike tl_type)

tools.name: tl_knowledge_last
tools.description: Get the last N tool steps from current or all sessions.

scope.description: Scope: current session or all sessions (default: session)

tools.name: tl_knowledge_search
tools.description: Search step history by tool name, screen, testId, or a11y name.

query.description: Search query (tool name, screen, testId, a11y name)

tools.name: tl_knowledge_sessions
tools.description: List recent sessions with metadata and step counts.

tools.name: tl_knowledge_summarize
tools.description: Generate a reusable recipe summary of a session.

sessionId.description: Session ID to summarize (default: current session)

tools.name: tl_launch
tools.description: Launch a Chrome browser with TronLink extension. Supports fixture presets: "default" (unlocked wallet with TRX), "onboarding" (fresh install).

fixture.description: Wallet fixture preset: "default" (unlocked, TRX balance), "onboarding" (fresh install), or custom name

headless.description: Run browser in headless mode (default: false for visual observation)

tools.name: tl_list_contracts
tools.description: List all deployed contracts with addresses.

tools.name: tl_list_flows
tools.description: List available flow recipes (common multi-step workflows like import_wallet, switch_network, transfer_trx). Call with id to get full step details for a specific flow. Use the returned steps with tl_run_steps after substituting {{param}} placeholders.

id.description: Flow recipe ID to get full details (e.g. "import_wallet", "switch_network", "transfer_trx"). Omit to list all flows.

tools.name: tl_list_testids
tools.description: List all data-testid attributes on the current page.

tools.name: tl_multisig_connect_ws
tools.description: Connect WebSocket to receive real-time pending multisig transaction notifications for an address.

address.description: TRON address to subscribe to pending multisig transactions

tools.name: tl_multisig_disconnect_ws
tools.description: Disconnect the multisig WebSocket listener.

tools.name: tl_multisig_list_tx
tools.description: Query multisig transaction list: pending/success/failed. Shows signature progress, threshold, current weight for each transaction.

address.description: TRON address to query transaction list for

is_sign.description: Filter: true = signed by me, false = unsigned (default: false)

tools.name: tl_multisig_query_auth
tools.description: Query multisig permissions for a TRON address: which addresses it controls and active permission details (threshold, weight, operations).

address.description: TRON address to query multisig permissions for (T-prefix, 34 chars)

tools.name: tl_multisig_submit_tx
tools.description: Submit a signed multisig transaction to the TRON multisig service. The service collects signatures and broadcasts when threshold is met.

expire_time.description: Expiration timestamp in ms (default: 24 hours from now)

transaction.description: Signed transaction object with raw_data and signatures

tools.name: tl_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a TronLink screen: home, settings, send, receive, swap, assets, notification, address_book, node_management, dapp_list, or a custom URL.

url.description: URL to navigate to (required when target is "url")

tools.name: tl_run_steps
tools.description: Execute multiple tool steps in sequence. Useful for complex multi-step flows.

tools.name: tl_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the TronLink extension or dApp page.

tools.name: tl_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page or a specific element. Supports direction (up/down/left/right) and pixel amount. Can target a scrollable container by a11yRef, testId, or CSS selector.

tools.name: tl_seed_contract
tools.description: Deploy a smart contract: trc20, trc721, trc1155, trc10, multisig, staking, energy_rental. E2E only.

tools.name: tl_seed_contracts
tools.description: Deploy multiple smart contracts in sequence. E2E only.

tools.name: tl_set_context
tools.description: Switch workflow context between e2e (testing with local chain) and prod (real networks).

tools.name: tl_switch_to_tab
tools.description: Switch to a browser tab by role (extension/dapp/notification) or URL pattern.

role.description: Role of the tab to switch to

tools.name: tl_type
tools.description: Type text into an input element. Supports a11yRef, testId, or selector targeting.

clear.description: Clear existing text before typing (default: true)

tools.name: tl_wait_for
tools.description: Wait for an element to reach a state (visible/hidden/attached/detached).

tools.name: tl_wait_for_notification
tools.description: Wait for TronLink notification popup (transaction confirmation, dApp connection request).

tools.name: tl_wallet_create
tools.description: Auto-generate an encrypted wallet (local_secure). Use this when no wallet exists and the user wants automatic setup. After creation, the wallet is immediately available for on-chain, gasfree, and multisig operations. Fund the generated address with TRX before performing write operations.

tools.name: tl_wallet_list
tools.description: List all agent-wallet wallets with their IDs, types, active status, and TRON addresses.

tools.name: tl_wallet_set_active
tools.description: Switch the active wallet by wallet ID. The new wallet will be used for all subsequent on-chain, gasfree, and multisig operations.

tools.name: connect_wallet
tools.description: Connect to TronLink wallet. ⚠️ ACTION REQUIRED: Please switch to your browser and approve/reject this request in the TronLink Signer page.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get TRX balance for an address

tools.name: send_trc20
tools.description: Send TRC20 tokens. ⚠️ ACTION REQUIRED: Please switch to your browser and approve/reject this request in the TronLink Signer page.

amount.description: Amount of tokens to send in human-readable units (e.g. '1.5' for 1.5 USDT). Decimals conversion is handled automatically.

decimals.description: Token decimals. Omit to auto-detect via the contract's decimals() view — required to avoid 10^N magnitude errors on non-6dp tokens (USDD/SUN/JST = 18dp).

tools.name: send_trx
tools.description: Send TRX to an address. ⚠️ ACTION REQUIRED: Please switch to your browser and approve/reject this request in the TronLink Signer page.

amount.description: Amount of TRX to send in human-readable units. Prefer a string (e.g. '1.5') to avoid floating-point precision loss for large amounts; numbers are still accepted for backward compatibility. Max 6 decimal places.

tools.name: sign_message
tools.description: Sign a message with the wallet. ⚠️ ACTION REQUIRED: Please switch to your browser and approve/reject this request in the TronLink Signer page.

tools.name: sign_transaction
tools.description: Sign a raw transaction. ⚠️ ACTION REQUIRED: Please switch to your browser and approve/reject this request in the TronLink Signer page.

broadcast.description: Whether to broadcast the signed transaction on-chain (default: false)

tools.name: sign_typed_data
tools.description: Sign EIP-712 typed data. ⚠️ ACTION REQUIRED: Please switch to your browser and approve/reject this request in the TronLink Signer page.

typedData.description: EIP-712 typed data object containing domain, types, primaryType and message
